title: Dictadura y democracia
goal: Read about Brazil's 1988 Constitution and Colombia's 1991 Constitution as tools used to expand rights rather than concentrate power, in contrast to how other leaders used constitutional reform.

items: Explain what the "Séptima Papeleta" movement achieved in Colombia.
Describe what the acción de tutela allows citizens to do.
State how the 1991 Colombian Constitution recognized indigenous and Afro-Colombian communities.
Use no solo... sino también to present two reinforcing facts.
